source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Collect data on the types of pollutants being emitted.
3. Measure the concentration levels of these pollutants.
4. Check the frequency of emissions and quantify volume.
5. Track meteorological data that may affect dispersion rates.
6. Document any abnormalities or consistently high readings.
7. Note any deviations from regulatory limits.
8. Collect and incorporate any photographic or video evidence of visible emissions.
9. Record any witness accounts or community complaints.
10. Analyze data to establish patterns or trends.
11. Prepare a summary of the findings.
12. Attach copies of any relevant permits or operational authorizations.
13. Include recommendations for corrective actions.
14. Date and sign the report, and identify yourself as the author.
15. Archive all underlying documentation for potential future reference.
